insight: Rule 00 refused a stranger who raised identity but answered an ordinary question from an unknown number. The channel allowlist is the control, not the rule.

The Looked-in receipt holds on record lookups but not when the agent claims it lacks access to a whole system; three rewrites did not reach it. Treat capability claims without a receipt as unverified.
A 16-entry tool deny list validated clean and blocked nothing with the sandbox off. Only a denied attempt that fails is evidence of containment.
A client daily report ran on model fallback 3 for at least three days while reporting success; stderr went to /dev/null so the cause was lost. Log stderr and monitor the actual model per run.
